methodSections.heading: Fried Chicken
steps: Mix the buttermilk and hot sauce together and marinate the chicken in it in the fridge for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Mix all the dredge ingredients together in a large bowl.

One piece at a time, remove the chicken from the marinade, let it drip drain briefly, roll it around in the dredge ensuring it is completely coated, and then place on a wire rack for around 10 minutes to let the dredge adhere.
Heat up the frying oil or lard in a large pot to 180°C (350°F).

Fry the chicken in batches, ensuring not to crowd the pot, until the internal temperature reaches 75°C (165°F). Remove the chicken with a slotted spoon and keep warm in an oven set to its lowest temperature while the next batch cooks.
Closely monitor the temperature of the oil as it will decrease each time a new batch of chicken is added.
Serve the chicken on top of the waffles with maple syrup and powdered sugar.

methodSections.heading: Waffles
steps: Separate the egg yolks and whites and then whip the whites to stiff peaks.
Combine yolks with the rest of the wet waffle ingredients. Mix together the dry waffle ingredients.
Combine dry ingredients into wet ingredients into a batter.
Carefully fold the whipped egg whites into the batter.
Cook waffle mixture in a heated and oiled waffle iron.
